categories.title: Footprint
categories.description: Keep every @tevm/* package lean, modular, and minimal in runtime dependencies.

metrics.title: Package source bytes
metrics.description: Keep each @tevm/* package's source footprint lean; split heavy adapters and avoid bundling dead code.

metrics.title: Module lines
metrics.description: Keep every production source module under 250 lines with one exported concept per file (AGENTS.md).

metrics.title: Runtime deps
metrics.description: Keep direct runtime dependencies minimal (<= 3 per core package); avoid pulling heavy libraries into core packages.

categories.title: Quality
categories.description: Enforce strict typing, JSDoc discipline, zero stray console calls, and TigerStyle function limits across packages.

metrics.title: Explicit any
metrics.description: Never use `: any` or `as any` in production source; use explicit types or `unknown` with narrowing.

metrics.title: Ts suppressions
metrics.description: Eliminate `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, and `@ts-nocheck` directives from production source.

metrics.title: Console calls
metrics.description: Never leave `console.log` or `console.debug` in library packages under `packages/`; route diagnostics through the logger.

metrics.title: Todo fixme
metrics.description: Resolve or convert `TODO`/`FIXME`/`HACK` comments into tracked issues or explained workarounds with removal conditions (AGENTS.md).

metrics.title: Function length
metrics.description: Keep functions at or under 70 lines (TigerStyle); decompose long handlers and parsers into focused helpers.

metrics.title: Jsdoc exports
metrics.description: Document every exported runtime symbol in `packages/*/src/` with complete JSDoc (AGENTS.md).

categories.title: Architecture & Testing
categories.description: Maintain high test depth per package, synchronized `tevm` facade exports, and valid documentation links.

metrics.title: Test ratio
metrics.description: Maintain at least an 80% test-to-source line ratio in every workspace package, especially `@tevm/cli` and `@tevm/errors`.

metrics.title: Tevm facade exports
metrics.description: Keep every subpath in `tevm/package.json` synchronized with its facade directory and barrel exports (AGENTS.md).

metrics.title: Docs links
metrics.description: Keep all relative Markdown links in `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `CLAUDE.md` valid.

categories.title: Factory & Trust
categories.description: Enforce Smithers Cloud trust boundaries, shared object store isolation, QuickJS Realm workflows, personalized home UI, Obsidian wiki, mythical history, and playground CSP integrity.

metrics.title: Trust boundary
metrics.description: Split read and write secrets on build.smithers.sh and prevent untrusted PRs from accessing write or publish tokens.

metrics.title: Cloud workflows
metrics.description: Keep every .smithers/workflows/*.ts workflow valid under Smithers Cloud's QuickJS Realm planner and aligned with factory.json triggers.

metrics.title: Home personalization
metrics.description: Keep .smithers/home.json valid under @smthrs/views with tailored maintainer, contributor, and viewer sections.

metrics.title: Wiki and history
metrics.description: Keep .smithers/coding-project.json, Obsidian [[wikilinks]], and .smithers/history/MYTHICAL.md synchronized and link-checked.

metrics.title: Playground csp
metrics.description: Keep .smithers/playground/index.html CSP SHA-256 hashes synchronized with inline script and style blocks.

mythicalHistory.title: 01. Foundations, Primitives, and BaseError Discipline
mythicalHistory.summary: Establish the monorepo package structure, strict BaseError hierarchy, JSON-RPC envelope types, and canonical Ethereum utilities.

chapters.title: Define @tevm/errors, @tevm/utils, and @tevm/common
chapters.notes: Every public error extends BaseError with standard JSON-RPC negative codes and structured diagnostic context.

chapters.title: Specify @tevm/jsonrpc and @tevm/http-client transport contracts
chapters.notes: Canonical hex quantities, even-length data hex, and explicit JSON-serializable wire contracts.

abandonedExperiments: Legacy JS-only EthereumJS state/vm wrappers were superseded by native ZEVM execution for performance and Ethereum Execution Spec parity.

mythicalHistory.title: 02. Native ZEVM, Guillotine Mini, and Voltaire Execution Core
mythicalHistory.summary: Power @tevm/node with the native Zig ZEVM engine, pinned sibling revisions, content-addressed addon stamps, and isolated node lifecycles.

chapters.title: Wire @tevm/node to native @evmts/zevm with deterministic addon stamping
chapters.notes: Native addon bytes are hashed into factory/native-addon.sha256 so every downstream Smithers target re-keys cleanly.

abandonedExperiments: Bundler Rust crates originally lived inside this monorepo before moving cleanly to evmts/tevm-bundler, keeping Cargo only for Voltaire crypto compilation.

mythicalHistory.title: 03. Viem-Native Memory Client, Actions, and Unified tevm Facade
mythicalHistory.summary: Expose eth_*, tevm_*, anvil_*, and debug_* JSON-RPC actions through a drop-in Viem memory client and synchronized tevm facade.

chapters.title: Implement typed JSON-RPC actions and contract wrappers
chapters.notes: Includes full mainnet/optimism forking, instant mining, account/storage mutation, and Solidity console.log draining.

chapters.title: Synchronize recursive barrels and tevm/package.json subpath exports
chapters.notes: Continuously verified by Uphill's tevm-facade-exports metric.

mythicalHistory.title: 04. Developer Tooling: CLI, Server, MCP, and Embedded Playground
mythicalHistory.summary: Deliver local JSON-RPC servers, interactive CLI workflows, an AI-ready @tevm/mcp server, and a sandboxed live EVM playground.

chapters.title: Ship @tevm/cli, @tevm/server, and @tevm/mcp
chapters.notes: Gives both human developers and AI agents isolated local Ethereum nodes.

chapters.title: Embed the sandboxed native ZEVM playground directly in Smithers Cloud
chapters.notes: Runs bounded deploy/call requests with CSP SHA-256 hash verification and opcode trace inspection.

mythicalHistory.title: 05. Conformance, Multi-Engine Fuzzing, Formal Specs, and Benchmarks
mythicalHistory.summary: Back every claim with Ethereum Execution Spec tests, multi-engine differential fuzzing, Lean specs, and cached incremental benchmarks.

chapters.title: Add incremental Smithers benchmarks and multi-engine fuzzing suites
chapters.notes: Unchanged packages hit the shared Smithers Cloud object store in milliseconds while touched packages re-benchmark automatically.

mythicalHistory.title: 06. Public Smithers Cloud Coding Factory and Lighthouse Backpressure
mythicalHistory.summary: Complete the switchover to public development on smithers.sh/evmts/tevm with split-privilege object store caching, BYOA MCP, personalized UI, and Uphill Lighthouse audits.

chapters.title: Declare .smithers/FACTORY.ts, QuickJS Realm workflows, trust boundary, and one-time sandbox auth
chapters.notes: Splits read-only untrusted contributor cache hits from maintainer/sandbox cache writes and merge gates.

chapters.title: Ship Lighthouse Uphill backpressure, Obsidian wiki, mythical history, and automated GitHub release/docs mirror
chapters.notes: Merges on Smithers Cloud mirror to GitHub main and automatically drive Changesets releases, Vocs docs + llms.txt, and wiki refreshes.

abandonedExperiments: Nx Cloud remote cache (nxCloudAccessToken) was retired in favor of the shared Smithers Cloud object store (https://build.smithers.sh) with split read/write secrets.

plugin.name: tevm-factory

plugin.summary: Deterministic checks, PR-history-derived agentic review, bounded repair recipes, and contributor-ready candidate gates for TEVM.

entries.summary: Validate issue policy, queue contracts, declarations, repository identity, generated contributor data, and source integrity.

entries.label: //factory:preflight
entries.title: Local preflight
entries.summary: Check the pinned toolchain and exact local Flows and Zevm sibling revisions before running agent lanes.

entries.label: //:mechanicalPrePush

entries.summary: Run repository lint, typecheck, and test gates without spending an agent seat.

entries.label: //:ci
entries.title: Complete CI
entries.summary: Build, cover, test, lint, document, validate Rust, and enforce factory and changeset policy across the monorepo.

entries.label: //factory:trustBoundaryTest
entries.title: Trust boundary audit
entries.summary: Verify build.smithers.sh read/write cache split and ensure untrusted PRs never receive write or publish secrets.

entries.label: //factory:sandboxAuthTest
entries.title: One-time sandbox auth
entries.summary: Verify single-use HMAC-SHA256 sandbox credential minting, replay protection, and privilege-escalation refusal.

entries.label: //factory:cloudWorkflowsTest
entries.title: Cloud workflow verifier
entries.summary: Verify every QuickJS-Realm cloud workflow, trigger binding, and personalized Smithers Home layout.

entries.label: //factory:wikiAndHistoryTest
entries.title: Wiki and mythical history
entries.summary: Verify Obsidian wikilinks, coding-project catalog integrity, and Mythical History markdown rendering.

entries.label: //factory:sourceIntegrity
entries.title: Source integrity
entries.summary: Reject merge markers, malformed generated output, and orphaned gitlinks.

entries.label: //factory:repositoryMetadataLint
entries.title: Repository metadata
entries.summary: Keep package and release-workflow provenance on the canonical evmts/tevm repository.

entries.label: //:agentLints
entries.title: All agentic lints
entries.summary: Review the applied diff for public API, tests, docs, changesets, wire contracts, regression proof, and scope coherence.

entries.label: //:rpcContractLint
entries.title: JSON-RPC wire contract
entries.summary: Check exact request, result, serialization, dispatch, error, and public-client surfaces for changed RPC code.

entries.label: //:regressionProofLint
entries.title: Regression proof
entries.summary: Judge whether a fix proves the failing public boundary, negative branches, state isolation, and equivalent inputs.

entries.label: //:scopeCoherenceLint
entries.title: Scope coherence
entries.summary: Distinguish coherent mechanical fan-out from unrelated or speculative change churn.

entries.label: //:prReview
entries.title: Pull-request review
entries.summary: Run the repository review checklist locally over the current diff.

entries.label: //factory:repositoryMetadataWrite

entries.summary: Apply the bounded mechanical repository-identity repair across manifests and release workflows.

entries.label: //workflows/fix-ci:fixCi
entries.title: Repair CI

entries.label: //workflows/upgrade-viem:upgradeViem

entries.label: //:preCommit

entries.label: //:prePush

entries.summary: Combine deterministic candidate checks with every PR-history-derived agentic lint.
